EnableCritical.Name: Effect on critical successes
EnableCritical.Hint: Shows the golden effect on a natural 20 (or the weapon's critical threshold).

EnableFumble.Name: Effect on critical failures
EnableFumble.Hint: Shows the dark effect on a natural 1.

RollTypes.Name: Rolls affected
RollTypes.Hint: Which d20 rolls trigger the effect.

Audience.Name: Who sees the effect
Audience.Hint: Private or blind rolls only trigger it for users who can see them.
Audience.Visible: Everyone who can see the roll

IncludeNpc.Name: Include NPCs
IncludeNpc.Hint: Uncheck to only trigger the effect for player characters.

CriticalSound.Name: Critical success sound
CriticalSound.Hint: Audio file to play. Leave empty for the built-in chime.

FumbleSound.Name: Critical failure sound
FumbleSound.Hint: Audio file to play. Leave empty for the built-in knell.

Volume.Name: Effect volume
Volume.Hint: Multiplied by Foundry's interface volume. 0 mutes.

Duration.Name: Effect duration (seconds)
Duration.Hint: Click the effect to dismiss it early.

Shake.Name: Shake on critical failures
Shake.Hint: Shakes the scene on a natural 1.

Test.Name: Test the effects
Test.Label: Test
Test.Hint: Opens a window to preview both effects.
